common.whyIntro: Haweenka iyo gabdhaha ku nool Kakuma Refugee Camp waxay la kulmaan caqabado badan, sida dhaqaale yari, waxbarasho hakad gasha, fursado kooban oo tababar xirfadeed ah, iyo caqabado ku wajahan shaqo helidda iyo daryeelka caafimaadka. Hooyooyinka da’da yar waxaa intaas u dheer inay isku dheelli tiraan daryeelka carruurta, waxbarashada iyo horumarkooda. Women Without Borders Hub waxay aaminsan tahay in gabar kasta iyo haweeney kasta oo da’ yar ay mudan tahay fursad ay caqabadaha uga gudubto, awooddeeda ku ogaato, mustaqbal wanaagsanna ku dhisato. Annagoo dhiirrigelinayna waxbarashada, xirfadaha wax-ku-oolka ah, hagidda, wacyiga caafimaadka iyo awood-siinta dhaqaale, waxaan doonaynaa in haweenka iyo gabdhuhu kalsooni yeeshaan, madaxbannaanidooda xoojiyaan, bulshadoodana wax ku biiriyaan.

quoteSection.quote: Every girl and young woman deserves a safe space to learn, grow, and believe in herself. When we support one another, share knowledge, and build our confidence, we create opportunities for a brighter future for ourselves and our community.
quoteSection.name: Khadijoh Mahamed
quoteSection.role: Member of Women Without Borders Hub
quoteSection.label: Xaad ka la mid
quoteSection.quote2: I founded Women Without Borders Hub because I believe that every girl and young woman deserves a chance to create a better future, regardless of the challenges she faces. Too many talented young women have dreams that remain out of reach because of financial hardship, limited opportunities, and barriers that hold them back. I want to help change that by creating opportunities for learning, empowerment, and personal growth, where every girl can discover her strengths, find her voice, and move forward with confidence.
quoteSection.role2: Founder of Women Without Borders Hub

contact.partnerText1: Women Without Borders Hub waa urur xaafidi ah oo ku shaqeeya kambiida Kakuma, Kenya. Wana ku soo dhaweeyaan dad, urur, foundation, maaliyade iyo saaxiibada la wadaagayo waxay ka qeexaan commit-ment yn uu xoojinay haweena iyo da'qadaha ka jira haystaha noloshumaanka iyo meelaha lagu qaado.
contact.partnerText2: Iyadoo aan barasho iyo xarfidda, talo-barasho, horumarka xirfadaha dhijitali ah iyo kuwa practical, barashada caafimaadta nadiifka, caawinta caafimaadka jinsiyada iyo isu-ubka iyo xoojinta dhaqaalaha ahaa, waxaan ka caawisaa gabayaha sida badan, hooyoyinka da'da iyo da'qadaha jiray sida ku habboon inay kalsoonaan, horumaraan xirfadaha iyo helaan fursado mustaqbalkii.
contact.partnerText3: Waxaan ku soo dhaweeyaan shaqooyin taas oo xoojinaya barnaamijyadeena oo ka caawisa inay tirsanayaan caqabadaha waxbarashada, horumarka shakhsiga iyo fursada dhaqaalaha ahaa. Haddii ay tahay deyn, khibrad arrimo, tababar, khad, ama tallaabooyin wada shaqo, taageeradaadu waxay ka caawin karnaa inaan abuurno fursado badan oo bulshadaha aan u shaqeyno.
contact.partnerText4: Isku darka, waxaan karnaa inaan kor u qaado sharaf, ku wanaajin, adag iyo fursado joogto ah, taasoo u ogolaan in gabayaha iyo da'qadaha jiray ay mustaqbalkooda u qaabeeyaan waxayna si togan ugu qayb qaadaan bulshadahooda.
contact.getInTouchText: Waxaan ku soo dhaweeyaan codsiyada shaqooyinka, wada shaqaynta barnaamijyada iyo fursada inaan isku shaqeeyno.
contact.closingText: Isku darka, waxaan karnaa inaan abuurno fursado oo gabayaha iyo da'qadaha jiray ay wax u bartaan, kora na ay kulmaan.

secondChanceDetail.intro: Waxaan taageernaa gabdhaha iyo haweenka ku nool Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma ee Kenya ee doonaya inay waxbarashadooda sii wataan, ka gudbaan caqabadaha waxbarashada, una dhistaan mustaqbal wanaagsan. Waxaan aaminsanahay in waxbarashadu tahay xaq, gabadh iyo haweeney kastana ay mudan tahay fursad ay wax ku barato, ku korto oo ay ku gaarto awooddeeda buuxda.
secondChanceDetail.whatImageAlt: Haweeney wax baranaysa inta lagu jiro cashar
whatParagraphs: Barnaamijkeenna Waxbarashada Fursadda Labaad wuxuu taageeraa gabdhaha iyo haweenka waxbarashadoodu hakad gashay ama aan helin fursad ay waxbarashadooda ku dhammaystaan. Dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale, waajibaadka qoyska, barakaca iyo caqabadaha kale ee noloshu waxay adkayn karaan sii wadista waxbarashada. Barnaamijkan waxaan ku dhiirrigelinnaa ku noqoshada waxbarashada, waxaanan gabdhaha iyo haweenka ku taageernaa inay yoolalkooda waxbarasho u raacaan kalsooni iyo go'aan adag.

Waxaan aaminsanahay in helitaanka waxbarashadu ka caawin karo haweenka iyo gabdhaha inay aqoon helaan, madaxbannaanidooda xoojiyaan, bulshooyinkooda si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan, una abuuraan fursado wanaagsan naftooda iyo qoysaskooda.

approachPoints.title: Kobcinta helitaanka waxbarashada
approachPoints.text: Ku dhiirrigelinta gabdhaha iyo haweenka inay ka faa'iidaystaan fursadaha waxbarasho oo ay sii wataan safarkooda waxbarashada.

approachPoints.title: Dhisidda kalsoonida
approachPoints.text: Ku dhiirrigelinta ardayda inay awooddooda rumaystaan oo ay gartaan qiimaha waxbarashada ee noloshooda.

approachPoints.title: Kordhinta wacyiga bulshada
approachPoints.text: Kobcinta fahamka muhiimadda waxbarashada iyo dhiirrigelinta taageerada gabdhaha iyo haweenka doonaya inay waxbarashada ku noqdaan.

approachPoints.title: Dhiirrigelinta waxbarashada nolosha oo dhan
approachPoints.text: Ka caawinta in la yeesho aragti wanaagsan oo ku saabsan waxbarashada, koboca qofka iyo fursadaha mustaqbalka.

secondChanceDetail.getInvolvedClosing: Taageeradaadu waxay naga caawin kartaa inaan kobcinno fursadaha waxbarasho ee gabdhaha iyo haweenka ku jira Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma, isla markaana aan ku dhiirrigelinno kuwa waxbarashadoodu hakad gashay inay yoolalkooda sii raacaan.
secondChanceDetail.getInvolvedFinal: Wadajir, waxaan abuuri karnaa bulsho ku dhiirrigelisa gabdhaha iyo haweenka inay wax bartaan, awooddooda kobciyaan, una shaqeeyaan mustaqbal rajo iyo madax-bannaani badan leh.

srhrDetail.title: Kobcinta Aqoonta, Karaamada iyo Doorashooyinka Xog-ogaalka ah
intro: Women Without Borders Hub, waxaan aaminsanahay in gabadh iyo haweeney kasta oo da'yar ay xaq u leedahay inay hesho macluumaad lagu kalsoon yahay oo ku saabsan caafimaadka galmada iyo taranka, iyadoo ku sugan deegaan ammaan ah, ixtiraam leh oo taageero bixiya.

Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma, ceebaynta, caqabadaha dhaqanka, wacyiga oo kooban iyo helitaanka oo ku adag macluumaad caafimaad oo sax ah waxay ku adkayn karaan dhalinyarada qaarkood inay si furan uga hadlaan caafimaadka galmada iyo taranka. Barnaamijkeenna SRHR wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa waxbarasho da'da ku habboon, waxbarashada asxaabta iyo wacyigelinta bulshada si wax looga qabto caqabadahan.
srhrDetail.howIntro: Waxaan gabdhaha iyo haweenka da'da yar u abuurnaa fursado ay wax ku bartaan, su'aalo ku weydiiyaan, aqoon ku wadaagaan, kalsoonina ku dhistaan si ay go'aanno xog-ogaal ah uga gaaraan caafimaadkooda iyo fayo-qabkooda.

ourApproach.title: Habkayaga
ourApproach.imageAlt: Hawl ganacsi oo hab-nololeed Kakuma ka socota
ourApproach.intro: Waxaan hiigsaneynaa inaan horumarino hindisayaal hab-nololeed oo wax ku ool ah, loo dhan yahay, bulshada ka tarjumaya, kana jawaabaya waayo-aragnimada dadka aan u adeegno.

items.title: Naqshad ay bulshadu hoggaamiso
items.text: Waxaan qiimeynaa waayo-aragnimada, mudnaanta iyo fikradaha haweenka iyo gabdhaha. Dhageysiga xubnaha bulshada wuxuu naga caawiyaa inaan aqoonsanno baahiyaha khuseeya oo aan qaabeyno hawlo ku habboon duruufahooda.

items.title: Ka-qaybgal ammaan ah oo loo dhan yahay
items.text: Waxaan hiigsaneynaa inaan dhiirrigelino jawi waxbarasho oo ixtiraam leh, halkaas oo ka-qaybgalayaasha si sharaf leh loola dhaqmo, ay wax ku biirin karaan, kana qayb qaadan karaan takoor la'aan. Ilaalinta iyo taageerada ku habboon waa inay udub dhexaad u ahaadaan hawlaha barnaamijka.

items.title: Barasho wax ku ool ah oo khusaysa
items.text: Waxaan aqoonsannahay muhiimadda xirfadaha ay ka-qaybgalayaashu u adeegsan karaan nolol maalmeedka, ganacsiga, tababarka ama waddooyinka shaqada. Hawluhu waa inay ka jawaabaan danaha ka-qaybgalayaasha iyo fursadaha jira.

items.title: Hagid iyo iskaashi
items.text: Waxaan qiimeynaa iskaashiga kooxaha bulshada, ganacsiyada maxalliga ah, bixiyeyaasha tababarka, loo-shaqeeyayaasha, barayaasha iyo ururrada kale ee ku biirin kara aqoon, agab ama fursado khuseeya.

items.title: Helitaanka fursadaha
items.text: Marka ay suurtagal tahay, waxaan hiigsaneynaa inaan ka-qaybgalayaasha ku xirno macluumaad ku saabsan tababar, horumarinta ganacsiga, suuqyada, shaqo-barashada iyo waddooyinka shaqada.

items.title: Barasho iyo isla xisaabtan
items.text: Waxaan dooneynaa inaan wax ka baranno hawlaha barnaamijka, dhageysanno jawaab-celinta ka-qaybgalayaasha, oo aan si hufan uga warbixinno horumarka. Marka hawlo la fuliyo, dabagalka wuxuu naga caawin karaa inaan fahanno ka-qaybgalka, aqoonsanno caqabadaha, oo aan horumarino taageerada mustaqbalka.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
intro: Livelihood & Economic Empowerment is one of our core programme areas. We work alongside women and girls, community members, educators, local organizations, and potential partners to identify barriers and explore practical ways to expand access to economic opportunities.

Our programme focuses on building knowledge, confidence, practical abilities, and connections that can help participants take steps toward employment, entrepreneurship, and sustainable income generation.

areas.title: Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: We promote entrepreneurship as one possible pathway toward economic independence. Through business learning and mentorship opportunities, women and girls can explore how to identify business ideas, understand customer needs, plan their activities, and develop the knowledge needed to manage a small business.

Topics may include identifying business opportunities, basic business planning, budgeting, record-keeping, customer service, pricing, marketing, and managing income and expenses. These skills can help aspiring entrepreneurs make informed decisions and approach business activities with greater confidence.

We also recognize the importance of learning from people with practical business experience. Where opportunities are available, connecting participants with local entrepreneurs and business mentors can help them understand common challenges and learn from real-life experiences.

areas.title: Skills Development and Vocational Training
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Skills Development and Vocational Training activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: Practical skills can open doors to employment, self-employment, and other livelihood opportunities. We aim to encourage access to relevant skills development and vocational learning that responds to the interests of participants and the needs of the local community.

Depending on available training opportunities and partnerships, this may include practical, technical, creative, or service-related skills that can help participants prepare for work or explore small income-generating activities.

Our approach emphasizes the value of continuous learning, practical experience, and the confidence to apply newly acquired skills. We seek to support pathways through which women and girls can identify their strengths and make informed decisions about their future.

areas.title: Business Mentorship and Guidance
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Business Mentorship and Guidance activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: Starting a business or pursuing employment can be challenging, especially for people who have limited access to professional networks and experienced advisers. Mentorship can help participants explore their goals, understand potential challenges, and identify realistic next steps.

Through mentorship opportunities, women and girls may receive guidance on setting goals, developing business ideas, improving decision-making, building confidence, and identifying resources that could support their progress.

We value mentorship that respects each participant's circumstances and encourages them to recognize their abilities. By learning from others and sharing experiences, participants can develop a stronger understanding of the opportunities available to them.

areas.title: Apprenticeships and Work Experience
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Apprenticeships and Work Experience activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: Practical work experience can help bridge the gap between learning and employment. Where suitable opportunities are available, we seek to encourage connections with skilled professionals, businesses, training providers, and other community partners that may offer apprenticeships or supervised learning experiences.

These opportunities can help participants gain practical knowledge, understand workplace expectations, develop professional habits, and become more familiar with the skills required in different fields.
Work-based learning can also help participants identify their interests, strengthen their confidence, and explore possible pathways toward employment or self-employment.

areas.title: Market Linkages and Networking
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Market Linkages and Networking activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: Access to customers, suppliers, professional contacts, and reliable information can make a difference for people who want to develop their livelihoods. We recognize that having a skill or business idea is only one part of the journey; participants may also need connections that help them find customers and explore markets.

Through potential partnerships and community networks, we aim to encourage opportunities for women and girls to learn about market needs, connect with relevant service providers, share ideas, and identify possible routes for promoting their products or services.
Stronger networks can help participants exchange knowledge, learn from other entrepreneurs, and explore opportunities to grow their activities over time.

areas.title: Employment Readiness and Referrals
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Employment Readiness and Referrals activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: For women and girls who want to pursue employment, preparing for work can involve more than technical skills. Communication, teamwork, problem-solving, time management, and confidence can all be important when seeking and maintaining employment.

We aim to promote awareness of employment preparation and, where appropriate opportunities exist, connect participants with relevant training providers, employers, job information, or employment referral services.

This support may include guidance on preparing for job opportunities, understanding workplace expectations, identifying relevant skills, and exploring available career pathways. Referrals depend on the availability and suitability of opportunities and do not guarantee employment.

areas.title: Financial Awareness and Responsible Money Management
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Financial Awareness and Responsible Money Management activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: Understanding how to manage money can help individuals make informed decisions about their personal finances and livelihood activities. We encourage the development of basic financial awareness, including planning expenses, saving where possible, managing business income, keeping financial records, and understanding the difference between costs, revenue, and profit.
These skills can support participants as they plan for their needs, evaluate business ideas, and work toward their financial goals.

We also recognize that financial circumstances differ from person to person. Our approach aims to promote practical, realistic learning that respects participants' situations and supports informed decision-making.

areas.title: Confidence, Leadership, and Economic Participation
areas.imageAlt: Women taking part in the Confidence, Leadership, and Economic Participation activity in Kakuma
paragraphs: Economic empowerment involves more than earning an income. It also includes having the confidence to make decisions, express ideas, participate in community life, and pursue personal goals.
We encourage women and girls to recognize their strengths, develop their leadership abilities, and take an active role in decisions that affect their livelihoods and futures.
By promoting confidence, collaboration, and access to information, we aim to support participants in becoming more active contributors to their households and communities.

getInvolvedCards.intro: Waxaa jira siyaabo badan oo aad ku taageeri karto himiladeenna: waqtigaaga iskaa wax u qabso ugu bixi, xirfadahaaga la wadaag, taageero dhaqaale bixi, haweenka da’da yar hag, ama nala samee iskaashi. Wax ku biirin kastaa waa muhiim, waxayna ballaarin kartaa fursadaha waxbarasho, xirfad-barasho, wacyiga caafimaadka iyo dhaqaalaha ee haweenka iyo gabdhaha ku nool Kakuma Refugee Camp. Wadajir, waxaan u gudbi karnaa caqabadaha, dhisi karnaa kalsooni, abuuri karnaa mustaqbal ay gabar iyo haweeney kasta oo da’ yar ku kobci karto.

volunteer.heroSentence: Waqtigaaga iyo xirfadahaaga ku caawi gabdhaha iyo haweenka da'da yar ee Kakuma inay bartaan, koraan oo horumaraan.
volunteer.intro: Tabaruceyaasheennu waxay naga caawiyaan barnaamijyada waxbarashada, xirfadaha, la-talinta, caafimaadka iyo awood-siinta dhaqaale. Noo sheeg sida aad jeclaan lahayd inaad u caawiso, kooxdayaduna waxay kula soo xiriiri doontaa laba maalmood oo shaqo gudahood.
